# murtadhaqahtan.github.io

> Personal GitHub Pages host of Murtadha Qahtan. Products: Layout Fixer – Wrong Keyboard Language Fix, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9N32C01ML8D1, US$1.99) that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout with one hotkey (e.g. "ghbdtn" → "привет", "hgsghl ugd;l" → "السلام عليكم"); RTL Text Fixer, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9NQC161JJM09, US$2.99) that makes Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Kurdish, Pashto, Sindhi, Uyghur, Hebrew and Yiddish text display correctly in apps without right-to-left support (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Unity, Blender); Mic Mute Hotkey, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9NXGCCP0WGZS, US$2.99) that mutes the microphone in every app with one global shortcut, with push-to-talk and an on-screen indicator; Keyboard Cleaning Lock, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9MZX0NKN1HTB, also listed as CleanLock) that locks the keyboard so you can wipe it; Remove Photo GPS, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9N42PPL8C1T4, also listed as NoGeo Photo Cleaner) that strips GPS and EXIF metadata from photos; and Sound Output Switcher, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9NPZFGQ7VHFD) that switches your default speakers or headphones with a global hotkey or the tray menu.

## Projects
- [Layout Fixer – Wrong Keyboard Language Fix](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/layout-fixer-site/): fix text typed in the wrong keyboard layout on Windows (62 standard layouts). Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/layout-fixer-site/llms.txt
- [Layout Fixer in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N32C01ML8D1)
- [RTL Text Fixer](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/rtl-text-fixer-site/): connected letters and correct right-to-left order for apps that break Arabic-script and Hebrew text (Arabic reshaper + Unicode bidi). Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/rtl-text-fixer-site/llms.txt
- [RTL Text Fixer in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NQC161JJM09)
- [Mic Mute Hotkey](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/mic-mute-site/): system-wide microphone mute for Windows 10/11 – global shortcut (default Win+Alt+A), push-to-talk / push-to-mute, always-on-top "Muted"/"Live" indicator, tray icon, 15 languages, offline. Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/mic-mute-site/llms.txt
- [Mic Mute Hotkey in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NXGCCP0WGZS)
- [Keyboard Cleaning Lock](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/cleanlock-site/): lock the keyboard (and optionally mouse) on Windows 10/11 to wipe it; unlock by button, Ctrl+Alt+U or timer. Also listed as CleanLock.
- [Keyboard Cleaning Lock in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MZX0NKN1HTB)
- [Remove Photo GPS](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/photoscrub-site/): remove GPS location and EXIF metadata from photos on Windows 10/11 before you share them. Also listed as NoGeo Photo Cleaner.
- [Remove Photo GPS in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N42PPL8C1T4)
- [Sound Output Switcher](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/sound-output-switcher-site/): switch your default speakers or headphones on Windows 10/11 with a global hotkey or the tray menu.
- [Sound Output Switcher in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NPZFGQ7VHFD)
